units.source_text: 不過，從比目魚的家裡逃出來，並不是真的想去找堀木商量什麼人生的「未來打算」，

en.t: But when I fled from Flounder's house, it was not because I truly meant to go and consult Horiki about some future plan for my life,

units.source_text: 我只不過是想讓比目魚暫時安心，哪怕是讓他有一點點的安心

en.t: I merely wanted to put Flounder at ease for the time being, even if only a little.

units.source_text: （與其說我是為了想爭取時間逃離更遠，

en.t: (It was not so much that I wanted to gain time so I could flee farther away,

units.source_text: 不如說是參照了偵探小說中的情節，才寫下了這段留言，

en.t: as that I wrote that note after borrowing a device from a detective novel,

units.source_text: 不，這種想讓他安心的念頭也不是不存在的，

en.t: No, it was not that I had no wish at all to reassure him,

units.source_text: 準確地說，我害怕會以此給比目魚帶來突如其來的打擊，從而使他驚慌失措。

en.t: More precisely, I was afraid that this would give Flounder a sudden shock and leave him bewildered.
